# scylladbcloud_vpc_peerings (Data Source)

The VPC peerings of a cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "scylladbcloud_vpc_peerings" "example" {
	cluster_id = 1337
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (Number) Cluster ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `vpc_peerings` (List of Object) VPC peerings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vpc_peerings))

<a id="nestedatt--vpc_peerings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vpc_peerings`

Read-Only:

- `allow_cql` (Boolean)
- `connection_id` (String)
- `peer_account_id` (String)
- `peer_cidr_blocks` (List of String)
- `peer_region_id` (Number)
- `peer_vpc_id` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `vpc_peering_id` (Number)
